text:
Sam K.: quick design question — thinking about making the rerank response include explicit per-candidate scoring metadata (normalized score + raw logit) and a model_hint so routing/telemetry can attribute cost/quality. thoughts?
Maria L.: sounds useful. current scores are just floats, no contract. how do you want to represent norm vs raw?
Sam K.: proposal: { candidates: [{ id, text, score_norm: 0..1, score_raw: float, model: "reranker-v2" }] } — keep old `score` alias for backward compat?
Josh P.: +1 on model attribution. but careful: adding fields changes payload size and may affect quota calculations. do we charge per-candidate now or keep per-request?
Rachel S.: we discussed earlier: per-candidate pricing gives better economics but breaks lots of callers. prefer option: keep billing unchanged by default, expose opt-in flag to switch to per-candidate units.
Sam K.: agreed. Add a query param/field `score_envelope=expanded|compact` and a `billing_mode=legacy|per_candidate`?
Lucas M.: infra note — per-candidate billing needs more meter endpoints, infra can emit counters but per-tenant hook required. storage/telemetry cost will increase.
Priya R.: for telemetry, we need histograms of score_norm and per-model quality metrics. dashboard should show p50/p90/p99 by model and fallback counts when routing falls back to other variants.
Maria L.: +1. also we should include a `model_affinity` tag (small enum) so console can group models in UI without leaking model names to customers.
Josh P.: compatibility path: add `compat_mode=true` so older SDKs still get `score` populated as before (score_norm) and new fields are present. server will accept both.
Sam K.: example response idea in proto form:
```
{
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "c-1", "score_norm": 0.92, "score_raw": 3.8, "model": "r2-xl", "model_affinity": "semantic"},
    {"id": "c-2", "score_norm": 0.41, "score_raw": -0.4, "model": "r1-base", "model_affinity": "lexical"}
  ],
  "meta": {"score_envelope": "expanded", "billing_mode": "legacy"}
}
```
Lucas M.: infra: if we keep `billing_mode` default legacy, meters unchanged. if per_candidate enabled, we emit per-candidate counters labeled by tenant+model. need rate of events estimate from product.
Priya R.: for dashboard UX: add a toggle to Console -> Routes -> Rerank to pick `prefer_low_cost_model` or `prefer_best_quality` with a knob for routing weight. also show expected token/candidate cost estimate when configuring.
Rachel S.: rollout plan: feature-flag the expanded envelope behind canary (20% orgs) + analytics event to catch integration errors. devex should publish migration guide and code snippets.
devex-bot: created PR #4123 for SDK updates and migration README (will link once CI passes).
infra-bot: canary deploy scheduled: rerank-expanded-envelope behind ff=rerank_expanded: rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% with failover to legacy response.
Josh P.: question: do we want to return `score_confidence` separate from `score_norm`? could help downstream thresholds. might be redundant — confidence requires eval semantics.
Priya R.: let's add `score_confidence` (0..1) but mark as algorithmic estimate. dashboard should show correlation plots between confidence and click-through in rollout.
Maria L.: small nit: keep field names short for telemetry efficiency: `s_norm`, `s_raw`, `s_conf`? open to bikeshedding.
Sam K.: prefer readable names for SDK users; we can compress in wire format later if cost is real.
Lucas M.: storage question — how long do we keep per-candidate telemetry? default 30d, tiered retention for enterprise. I'll add to infra ticket.
Rachel S.: action items: Sam to draft API spec + examples, Priya to mock dashboard panes, Lucas to size telemetry, Maria/Josh to update SDK + compat tests, Rachel to own rollout plan.
Sam K.: I'll post an API PR today and tag everyone. thanks all :thumbsup:
